headline: Congress grinds to a halt with back-to-back pro forma sessions as both chambers return to D.C. Monday with skeleton crews.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on Thursday, October 15, with no substantive business conducted. The brief meeting lasted less than a minute before the chamber adjourned until Monday.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met for just over an hour on Thursday, October 15, introducing 30 new bills and 5 resolutions with no floor votes or quorum calls. Representative Wittman was appointed to act as Speaker pro tempore for the day.
